## Kyoto Two-Day Low-Stress Entertainment Plan
A relaxed 2-day plan for 2 adults that keeps transit simple, blends live music, quiet cafes, and one museum visit, and stays within a very lean **¥18,000 total** for both days by favoring free/low-cost stops and one paid museum.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary
### Day 1: Higashiyama + Gion evening
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Start with an easy walk around **Maruyama Park** and the quieter lanes near **Yasaka Shrine**; keep it unhurried and photo-light.
- Afternoon: Pause at a calm café in **Gion** or along **Shirakawa** for coffee and a dessert break, then browse a few small streets on foot.
- Evening: Do one live-music night at a small Kyoto venue or jazz bar in the city center; choose an early set so the night stays low-key.

### Day 2: Museum + riverfront cafés + live music
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- Morning: Visit **Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art** for your one museum stop; go at opening time to avoid crowds and keep the rest of the day easy.
- Afternoon: Head to a quiet café near **Kamogawa** or **Kawaramachi** for tea/coffee and a rest, then take a gentle riverside walk.
- Evening: Finish with a second live-music option, ideally a jazz café or small acoustic set; if you feel tired, swap this for a slow dinner and an early return.

## Budget-Friendly Kyoto Plan
| Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening | Est. Cost for 2 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Park and shrine walk | Café stop in Gion | Live music / jazz bar | ¥4,000–¥7,000 |
| 2 | Museum visit | Riverside café + walk | Live music or quiet dinner | ¥6,000–¥10,000 |
| Total |  |  |  | **¥10,000–¥17,000** |

### Cost notes
- Museum admission is the main fixed cost; choose one paid museum only.
- Cafes can stay affordable if you split one drink + one dessert per stop.
- Live music can range from cover-free to a modest cover charge; aim for early sets and one drink minimum.
- Using walking and local transit keeps costs low and stress down.
